messages.settings.heading: GAME SETTINGS
messages.settings.title: Rules players should know before they begin
messages.settings.explanation: These choices travel with the game on PC and consoles. A battle override changes only that battle.
messages.settings.turn_order.alternating_help: Each side chooses one character, then play passes to the other side.
messages.settings.turn_order.side_blocks_help: One side moves its company in any order, then the other side acts.
messages.settings.turn_order.initiative_help: Every character is interleaved according to initiative.
messages.settings.turn_order.fallback_help: Choose who acts next when a battle has no override.
messages.settings.loss.permanent_help: Fallen characters are permanently removed from the company.
messages.settings.loss.recoverable_help: Fallen characters leave the battle, then return to the company afterward.
messages.settings.invulnerable_help: A testing aid, not a difficulty mode. Turn it off before release.
messages.settings.revision_help: Increase this when exported content changes. Versions only move forward here.
messages.settings.closeups_help: Players begin here, then may override this in their own display settings.
